An e2-small has 2 GiB. Container limits total 1024 MiB (bundler) / 768 MiB (gateway), leaving ~450 MiB for the OS, dockerd and host nginx. Sustained pressure means a container is leaking past its measured p99 (alto 0.261 GiB, gateway instance 0.31 GiB) or the VM is undersized.

Requires the Ops Agent (installed by infra/vm/startup.sh) — agentless metrics do not include memory.

Action: check `docker stats`; if genuinely undersized, move to e2-medium (~$33/mo vs ~$20).
